svg.text: Order Management System — Architecture Detail: Azure vs Azure Local
How the order queue, document archive and ledger are re-bound when the workload moves. Companion to the business-continuity story diagram.
PORTABLE LAYER — IDENTICAL IN BOTH ENVIRONMENTS
Azure Policy · Azure Monitor · Defender — native cloud control plane
AKS enabled by Azure Arc · Microsoft.Kubernetes/connectedClusters
OIDC · Kerberos / LDAP · PKI trust chain
Arc control plane — Azure Policy, Monitor and Defender still reach back (connected)
→ No Azure data-plane PaaS types emitted at all
→ Identity moves off Entra onto Keycloak + AD DS
TECHNICAL IMPACT — WHAT DEGRADES, AND WHY
Both broker impls ship in the image.
SQL and Blob keep the same wire
federates to AD DS, AD CS issues
More guidance on this to follow.
